title: Senior CRM Executive
description:
Senior CRM Executive

Liverpool On-Site Salary: DOE Full-time Permanent

We're working with a growing business in Liverpool looking to add a Senior CRM Executive to its marketing team.

This is a hands-on opportunity for someone who enjoys getting into the detail of CRM, understanding customer behaviour and using data to improve engagement and retention.

You'll have the opportunity to take ownership of campaigns across multiple channels, develop automated customer journeys and work closely with teams across the wider business.

The Role

You'll be responsible for:

Managing the end-to-end delivery of CRM campaigns across multiple channels

Building, scheduling and optimising email campaigns

Developing and improving automated customer journeys

Creating targeted customer segments using behavioural and transactional data

Supporting CRM activity around key trading periods and campaigns

Working closely with Marketing, Ecommerce and Creative teams

Supporting customer retention and loyalty initiatives

Analysing campaign performance and identifying opportunities for improvement

Testing different audiences, messaging and customer journeys

Helping develop the wider CRM and retention strategy

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone with 2+ years' experience within CRM, retention, email marketing or a similar role.

You'll ideally have experience across areas such as:

CRM campaign management

Email marketing

Marketing automation

Customer segmentation

Automated journeys

Personalisation

Campaign analysis and reporting

A/B testing and optimisation

Experience using Klaviyo or another CRM/ESP platform would be beneficial.

You'll need to be organised, commercially minded and comfortable managing multiple campaigns while working with different teams across the business.

What's On Offer

Competitive salary, depending on experience

Permanent, full-time position

Liverpool-based opportunity

Generous holiday allowance

Company bonus scheme

Employee discount

Additional company benefits

If you're currently working within CRM and looking for an opportunity where you can take more ownership and continue developing your experience, I'd be keen to speak with you.

title: Marketing Executive / Manager (part time)
description:
Marketing Executive / Manager

And Serve Limited - Baltic Triangle, Liverpool (office-based)

Part-time, 3 days per week (Tuesday-Thursday or Wednesday-Friday), with potential to grow into a full-time role

£16-£20 per hour, depending on experience

About us

And Serve is a Liverpool-based company that designs, supplies and installs kitchens and bars for restaurants, bars, hotels and venues. Our group also includes Bar Blades, an online shop selling professional bar tools and accessories, and Ice and Easy Rentals, our hospitality rentals brand.

We're a small, ambitious team looking for a hands-on marketer to help grow all three brands.

The role

You'll work directly with the Director and take ownership of marketing for And Serve, Barblades and Iceandeasy. That means running day-to-day content and campaigns and also helping shape the longer-term marketing strategy. The work is varied. One day you might plan a paid social campaign for Barblades, and the next you could represent And Serve at a hospitality networking event.

The role is based at our office in Liverpool's Baltic Triangle. It starts at three days per week, either Tuesday to Thursday or Wednesday to Friday, with clear potential to become full-time as the businesses grow.

Key responsibilities
- Plan, create and schedule social media content across Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook and TikTok for each brand, and grow engagement and following.
- Produce and send regular email newsletters, manage subscriber lists, and use performance data to improve open and click-through rates.
- Set up, manage and optimise paid digital advertising on Meta, Google Ads and LinkedIn, staying within agreed budgets and reporting on return on spend.
- Plan and deliver offline marketing, including print materials, trade shows, direct mail and industry publications.
- Attend and help organise networking and industry events that build relationships and generate leads for And Serve.
- Keep each brand's tone and visual identity consistent across every channel.
- Track and report on marketing performance, and recommend where to focus time and budget.
- Update website content and product listings when needed, including on Shopify.

About you
- Proven marketing experience, ideally in both B2 B and e-commerce or B2 C.
- Confident running social media, email marketing and paid digital advertising on your own.
- Comfortable with traditional marketing and happy to represent the business face to face at events.
- Organised and self-motivated, able to handle several brands and priorities with little supervision.
- A strong writer with a good eye for design, using Canva, Adobe or similar tools.
- Comfortable with analytics and email tools such as Meta Business Suite, Google Analytics, Klaviyo or Mailchimp.
- Experience in hospitality, catering or events is a real plus, but not essential.

What we offer
- £16-£20 per hour, depending on experience.
- Part-time hours to start (Tue-Thu or Wed-Fri), with a route to full-time. Flexible start and finish times.
- An office in Liverpool's Baltic Triangle, one of the city's most creative business districts.
- Real ownership and influence, working directly with the Director and seeing the results of your work.
- Variety across three brands in different markets.
- The chance to grow your role as the business grows.

title: Operations & Social Media Coordinator
description:
Operations & Social Media CoordinatorLiverpool £28,000-£30,000 Full-Time Permanent

Adaptable Recruitment are delighted to be working exclusively with a successful and growing Liverpool-based cleaning services business to recruit an Operations & Social Media Coordinator.

This is a genuinely varied role combining customer service, operations, scheduling, administration and social media management within a fast-paced, service-led environment.

Essential Requirements - Please Read Before Applying

To be considered for this position, you must:
- Hold a Full UK Driving Licence
- Be willing to occasionally support cleaning operations when required
- Be available for weekend working on a rotating rota
- Have previous experience managing social media for a business

The RoleOperations & Customer Service
- Acting as a key point of contact for customers via phone, email and messaging platforms
- Managing customer enquiries, bookings and day-to-day communication
- Coordinating schedules and supporting operational planning
- Handling last-minute changes and resolving issues efficiently
- Maintaining accurate records, systems and internal databases
- Providing general administrative support across the business
- Supporting the wider team to ensure the smooth delivery of services

Social Media & Marketing
- Managing business social media accounts across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
- Creating engaging content including posts, stories, reels and promotional campaigns
- Scheduling content through Meta Business Suite and similar platforms
- Designing branded graphics and promotional materials using Canva
- Monitoring engagement and helping shape future content strategies
- Supporting brand awareness and business growth through creative content

Operational Support
- Supporting wider business operations as required
- Occasionally assisting cleaning teams during staff shortages, holiday cover or busy periods
- Travelling between locations where required to support operational needs

About You

We're looking for someone who has:
- Excellent customer service and communication skills
- Strong organisational and time management abilities
- The ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Previous experience managing social media for a business
- Experience creating content across Facebook, Instagram and TikTok
- Knowledge of Meta Business Suite
- Experience using Canva or similar design tools
- Strong written communication skills
- A positive, solutions-focused attitude
- The confidence to work independently and use initiative
- A flexible, hands-on approach
- A Full UK Driving Licence

What's On Offer?
- Salary of £28,000-£30,000 depending on experience
- Permanent, full-time opportunity
- Genuine variety and responsibility from day one
- The opportunity to make a real impact within a growing business
- Supportive and collaborative team environment
- Long-term career development opportunities
- A role where no two days are the same

If you're looking for a varied role where you can combine operations, customer service, administration and social media management, and you're happy to take a hands-on approach when needed, we'd love to hear from you.
